title: Use original-text coordinates in Unicode memory excerpts
problem: search_memories uses positions from casefolded text to slice original text. Unicode expansions before a keyword can yield an empty or unrelated excerpt despite a matching record.
acceptance_criteria: Keep Unicode casefold keyword matching while locating the earliest matching term in original text coordinates; a folded match inside an expanded character starts at that original character.
Excerpt starts at most 120 original characters before that hit and remains at most 500 original characters. Preserve first occurrence and earliest term regardless of keyword order.
Preserve ASCII search, no-match results, metadata, speaker/order/snapshot/pagination semantics and all existing tests. Add synthetic generated-journal unittest fixtures; no live data or network.
exclusions: Only the described behavior and one new regression-test file. No dependency, UI, network, existing-test, or unrelated source changes.
